annotations.text:
What changed in the rail
• BOOM word gone. The amber edge alone is the resolve, and a one-line legend above the grid names cast / snap / resolve once.
• Snap marker on Beats of 3+ steps: a diamond on a dashed seam, hollow tail = frozen on the snapshot. Default is the cast step, so existing Beats look the same.
• Rows on a fixed 32px pitch with an aligned number gutter and a visible hover state; step actions as icons on any hovered row. Steps are not reorderable.
• Beat labels wrap to two lines instead of truncating at a word.
• Variant halves carry their letter on the colour strip.
• New Beat buttons stand out from the section background.
• Hovering a Beat draws its snap seam across the rail so the step it lands on is unmistakable.
• Card body drags the whole Beat; the edges move one end each. Today only the halves resize.

Numbered steps, no names
The step column is a 24px number gutter and every per-row action is gone: add a step with the + under the list, delete with Del on the selected step, split from the Beat side. The rail drops from 480px to about 366px while the lanes grow from 66px to 92px, so labels fit on one line. Selected and hovered steps are bands across all lanes, which is how you read which step a card edge sits on without a name.
